summary: Roche reports an ATOMIC disease-free-survival benefit supporting this biomarker-defined adjuvant application. Overall-survival benefit is not established, and safety and manufacturing are not characterized in the supplied packet.
pivotalQuestion: Does ATOMIC’s disease-free-survival benefit provide an adequate benefit-risk basis for this biomarker-defined adjuvant use?

factors.rationale: Roche reports improved disease-free survival with atezolizumab plus FOLFOX6 in randomized phase 3 ATOMIC. This supports stage III dMMR/MSI-H colon cancer, not an overall-survival benefit or use in all colorectal cancers.
The supplied summaries provide no interpretable safety results for this adjuvant combination; absence of a disclosed concern does not establish favorable safety.
No application-specific manufacturing, facility-compliance, or CMC findings are supplied.

Roche reports priority review of the supplemental applications for Tecentriq and Tecentriq Hybreza; its July update continues to list the filing. These are process milestones, not evidence of approval.
